payload.rationale: IEEE 519-2022 Section 5 governs current distortion limits and Total Demand Distortion (TDD) at the point of common coupling (PCC) for non-linear power loads such as VFDs, EV fast chargers, and solar inverters. This deterministic verifier evaluates individual harmonic current distortion, even-harmonic derating (25% rule), high-voltage attenuation, and overall TDD compliance across standard short-circuit ratio tiers.
